description: Industry classification for any company: returns its primary industry with NAICS and SIC codes and their official titles, sector, subsector, an industry definition, and a confidence score. For firmographic segmentation, territory and market sizing, compliance, and underwriting. Cost: $0.25 USDC via x402.

language.description: Optional. Two-letter code for results in that language (default English): fr, de, it, es, ja, pt, zh, ar, nl, el, tr, ko, sv, vi, th, id. Same price in every language.

name: interzoid_industry_classification
